_comment: Env-var overlay for the staging ECS task definition. Merged into containerDefinitions[0].environment / .secrets by the Deploy (staging) workflow (see .github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml -> 'Patch env vars from committed overlay'). Values starting with 'tf:' are resolved from `terraform output -json` at deploy time; the suffix after 'tf:' is the Terraform output name. Literal strings pass through. NODE_ENV=production is deliberate — staging also runs with production safety-gates on so the clearance stub refuses to boot. See docs/runbooks/prod-env-provisioning.md.

environment._comment: PR #29 landed a prod-boot guard on StubAspProvider that refuses NODE_ENV=production unless this env is exactly '1'. Staging runs NODE_ENV=production and uses the stub, so we opt in here. Boot log is loud about it. Remove this entry once the real TransmissionProvider is wired (ClearTax partner ASP credentials land).
environment.name: ALLOW_STUB_ASP_IN_PRODUCTION

environment._comment: DATABASE_URL is injected by the workflow's 'Resolve DB connection string' step. The RDS master secret stores {username,password} JSON, not a postgres:// URL, so the workflow assembles the URL on the runner from the master secret + RDS endpoint and overrides whatever placeholder sits here. Mirrors the migrate job's logic.
environment.name: DATABASE_URL

_secrets_comment: COGNITO_CLIENT_SECRET deliberately NOT wired via ECS secrets[].valueFrom today. The Cognito app client runs without a client secret by default (see infra/modules/auth/main.tf, generate_secret = false) and CognitoAuthService handles the no-SECRET_HASH path. Previously this slot pointed at the SM placeholder and every task start failed with ResourceInitializationError during the 2026-11-27 deploy; the task_execution role already carries the needed IAM policy (PR #40) if we ever re-enable this. To restore, add { "name": "COGNITO_CLIENT_SECRET", "valueFrom": "tf:cognito_client_secret_arn" } here.
